description: Retrieve the style objects of a BloX widget.

dashboard_id.description: The ``oid`` of the dashboard that contains the widget.

admin_access.description: When ``True`` (default), appends ``?adminAccess=true`` to the request, allowing access to dashboards the API token user does not own.

description: Update the style objects of a BloX widget.

dashboard_id.description: The ``oid`` of the dashboard that contains the widget.

widget_id.description: The ``oid`` of the BloX widget to update.

current_card.description: Replacement for the ``style.currentCard`` object. Omit to leave the current value unchanged.

current_config.description: Replacement for the ``style.currentConfig`` object. Omit to leave the current value unchanged.

executing_user_id.description: Sisense user ID of the user who should own the dashboard during the write. Required when the API token user is not the dashboard owner.
